title: Parmesan-Roasted Cabbage Wedges
description: This utterly delicious, elegant vegetable side dish of Parmesan Roasted Cabbage Wedges came about from cleaning out our refrigerator. The result is a dish suited for your finest dinner party. Here's an easy and elegant way to transform a humble vegetable to rock star status. Parmesan Roasted Cabbage Wedges are easy and elegant!
ingredients: 1/2 medium head of green cabbage, cut into 4 wedges
salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
2 cups freshly grated Parmesan cheese plus more shaved into "shards" for garnish.
directions: Line a baking sheet with non-stick aluminum foil. Spray with cooking spray. (Maybe not!)
Season melted butter with salt and black pepper to taste. Brush over cut side of cabbage wedges. Dredge each cabbage wedge in the Parmesan cheese and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes. Carefully flip and bake 10-15 minutes more.
Remove from oven and drizzle any browned butter on the pan back over the cabbage. Top with additional shaved Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately.
